# setup

Volcano plots of the TCR library screen, from the edgeR tables of `script-hit-identification-TCL.Rmd`.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
})
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
project_dir <- normalizePath(file.path(setup_dir, ".."), mustWork = TRUE)
results_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "tcr-library")
edger_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "edger")
plot_list <- list()
```

# hits

Three panels, one per target of the library: the autologous VHIO-136 tumor cell line (relevant), an irrelevant
TCL used as a specificity control (NCI3998 in screen 1, VHIO-008 TCL in screen 2), and the VHIO-008 B cells (positive control).

A TCR called as a hit in all three comparisons (relevant, irrelevant and B-cell) is enriched regardless
of the target, so it is not antigen-specific: the highlighted hits are those called in `relevant` minus
those shared by the three. The irrelevant panel highlights nothing: no hit is expected there.

```{r}
# --- Read the hits file of an edgeR comparison (uses edger_dir) ---
read_hits <- function(comparison, file) {
  path <- file.path(edger_dir, comparison, file)
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing hits file (run script-hit-identification-TCL.Rmd first): ", path)
  readLines(path)
}
relevant_hits <- read_hits("relevant", "relevant_pos_hits.txt")
bcell_hits <- read_hits("positive", "positive_hits.txt")
irrelevant_hits <- read_hits("irrelevant", "irrelevant_pos_hits.txt")
hits <- list(
  relevant = setdiff(relevant_hits, Reduce(intersect, list(relevant_hits, irrelevant_hits, bcell_hits))),
  irrelevant = NULL,
  positive = c("NKI.CDK.53_mutCDK4", "PMEL17_gp100")
)
cat("relevant hits:", length(relevant_hits), "->", length(hits$relevant),
    "after removing the ones called in all three comparisons:",
    paste(setdiff(relevant_hits, hits$relevant), collapse = ", "), "\n")
write.table(hits$relevant, file = file.path(results_dir, "relevant_hits_specific.txt"),
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)
```

# plots

```{r, warning=FALSE}
for (i in names(hits)) {
  folder <- i
  file <- paste0(folder, ".txt")
  data <- read.table(file = file.path(edger_dir, folder, file), header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
    mutate(
      highlight = ifelse(TCR %in% hits[[folder]], TCR, "no_hits"),
      is_no_hit = highlight == "no_hits",
      significant_hit = !is_no_hit & FDR <= 0.05 & logFC > 1.5
    )
  tcr_signif <- unique(data$highlight[data$significant_hit])
  palette_blues <- brewer.pal(9, "Set1")[1:7]
  colors_tcr <- setNames(colorRampPalette(palette_blues)(length(tcr_signif)), tcr_signif)
  write.table(x = as.data.frame(colors_tcr), sep = "\t",
              file = file.path(edger_dir, folder, paste0("color_palette_", i, ".txt")))
  colors_tcr["no_hits"] <- "gray90"
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      alpha = ifelse(FDR <= 0.05 & logFC > 1.5, 1, 0.5),
      fill_color = case_when(
        is_no_hit & !(FDR <= 0.05 & logFC > 1.5) ~ "white",
        is_no_hit ~ "gray90",
        !is_no_hit ~ colors_tcr[highlight],
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  data <- data[order(data$is_no_hit, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = logFC, y = logFDR)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = fill_color, shape = is_no_hit, alpha = alpha),
      color = "black", stroke = 0.1,
      size = ifelse(data$is_no_hit, 2, 4),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 21, "FALSE" = 21)) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_alpha_identity() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1.30103, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    labs(title = folder, x = "logFC", y = "logFDR") +
    xlim(-5, 5) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(-1, 20)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.position = "none",
      aspect.ratio = 1.25
    )
  plot_list[[i]] <- plot
  # --- Each panel on its own, next to the edgeR results of its comparison ---
  pdf(file = file.path(edger_dir, folder, paste0("volcano_", i, ".pdf")),
      width = 297 / 60, height = 210 / 40)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()
}
# --- The three panels together ---
pdf(file = file.path(results_dir, "volcano.pdf"), width = 297 / 20, height = 210 / 20)
print(wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 3, nrow = 1))
dev.off()
rm(i, folder, file, data, tcr_signif, palette_blues, colors_tcr, plot)
```

```{r}
print("Plots saved successfully.")
```
